function.name: create_file
function.description: Creates a new file with the specified content in the given path. If the path includes non-existent directories, they will be created.

file_path.description: The full path where the file should be created, including its name and extension (e.g., 'documents/report.txt').

content.description: The content to write into the new file.

overwrite.description: If true, overwrites the file if it already exists; otherwise, returns an error. Defaults to false.

function.name: read_file_content
function.description: Reads and returns the content of a specified file. Useful for retrieving text-based file data.

file_path.description: The full path to the file whose content is to be read (e.g., 'config/settings.json').

encoding.description: The character encoding to use when reading the file (e.g., 'utf-8', 'latin-1'). Defaults to 'utf-8'.

function.name: list_directory_contents
function.description: Lists all files and subdirectories within a specified directory path. Provides details like size and last modified date.

directory_path.description: The path to the directory whose contents are to be listed (e.g., 'logs/', 'users/').

include_subdirectories.description: If true, recursively lists contents of subdirectories. Defaults to false.

filter_by_extension.description: Optional file extension to filter results (e.g., 'txt', 'pdf'). Do not include the dot.

min_size_kb.description: Minimum file size in kilobytes to include in the results.

max_results.description: Maximum number of items to return.

function.name: delete_file_or_directory
function.description: Deletes a specified file or an empty directory. If deleting a directory, it must be empty unless 'recursive' is set to true.

path.description: The full path to the file or directory to be deleted (e.g., 'temp/old_data.csv', 'backup/').

is_directory.description: Set to true if the path refers to a directory. Defaults to false (assumes a file).

recursive.description: If true, recursively deletes directory and its contents. Only applicable when 'is_directory' is true. Defaults to false.

function.name: move_file_or_directory
function.description: Moves a file or directory from a source path to a destination path. Can also be used to rename an item by providing a new name in the destination path.

source_path.description: The current full path of the file or directory to be moved (e.g., 'drafts/report.docx').

destination_path.description: The new full path for the file or directory, including its new name if renaming (e.g., 'final/report_v2.docx').

overwrite_if_exists.description: If true, overwrites the destination if a file or directory already exists there. Defaults to false.

function.name: get_file_metadata
function.description: Retrieves metadata for a specified file, such as size, creation date, last modified date, and permissions.

file_path.description: The full path to the file for which metadata is requested (e.g., 'images/profile.jpg').

function.name: create_social_post
function.description: Publishes a new social media post to a specified platform with given content and optional scheduling.

platform.description: The social media platform to post to (e.g., 'Facebook', 'Twitter', 'X', 'LinkedIn', 'Instagram').

content.description: The text content of the social media post.

media_url.description: Optional URL of an image or video to attach to the post.

scheduled_time.description: Optional ISO 8601 formatted datetime string for scheduling the post in the future. If not provided, the post is published immediately.

tags.description: Optional comma-separated list of tags or hashtags to include with the post.

is_draft.description: If true, the post is saved as a draft instead of being published or scheduled. Defaults to false.

function.name: get_scheduled_posts
function.description: Retrieves a list of all social media posts that are currently scheduled for future publication, optionally filtered by platform.

platform.description: Optional filter to retrieve scheduled posts for a specific social media platform.

limit.description: Maximum number of scheduled posts to return. Defaults to 100.

offset.description: Number of scheduled posts to skip from the beginning. Useful for pagination.

function.name: update_social_post
function.description: Modifies an existing social media post, which can be a draft, scheduled post, or even a recently published post if the platform allows edits.

post_id.description: The unique identifier of the post to update.

platform.description: The social media platform where the post exists.

new_content.description: Optional new text content for the post.

new_media_url.description: Optional new media URL to replace or add to the post.

new_scheduled_time.description: Optional new ISO 8601 formatted datetime string to reschedule the post.

new_tags.description: Optional comma-separated list of new tags or hashtags for the post.

function.name: delete_social_post
function.description: Deletes a social media post, whether it's a draft, scheduled, or already published.

post_id.description: The unique identifier of the post to delete.

platform.description: The social media platform from which to delete the post.

confirm_deletion.description: Must be true to confirm the deletion action. This is a safety measure.

function.name: get_post_analytics
function.description: Retrieves analytical data for a specific social media post, such as likes, comments, shares, and reach.

post_id.description: The unique identifier of the post for which to retrieve analytics.

platform.description: The social media platform where the post is located.

metric_type.description: Optional filter for specific metric types (e.g., 'likes', 'comments', 'shares', 'reach', 'impressions'). If not provided, all available metrics are returned.

start_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 formatted start date for the analytics period.

end_date.description: Optional ISO 8601 formatted end date for the analytics period.

function.name: publish_draft_post
function.description: Publishes an existing social media draft post immediately or schedules it for a future time.

draft_id.description: The unique identifier of the draft post to publish.

platform.description: The social media platform where the draft exists.

scheduled_time.description: Optional ISO 8601 formatted datetime string for scheduling the post. If not provided, the post is published immediately.
